primary_goal: Finish a playable ground combat RTS prototype loop before expanding scope.

default_sequence: summarize direction in 5 lines or less
behavior_rules: Do not stop after one small step.
Work in 30 to 60 minute chunks when possible.
Avoid unnecessary questions when a reasonable assumption is safe.
Do not overwrite local uncommitted changes.

world_direction.summary: Grand crusade, giant empire, and space-scale sci-fi warfare.
world_direction.player_faction: Heavy armored crusade empire with sacred imperial symbolism and sci-fi weapons.
world_direction.enemy_faction: Opposing sci-fi war civilization with stronger frontal firepower feel.
avoid: generic sci-fi without sacred imperial weight
primitive placeholder visuals as the final direction

current_focus: protect the ground combat prototype direction
improve battlefield readability and faction identity
support home AI development with better instructions and harness files

immediate: Show minimap as current camera view area instead of only a camera position dot.
Fix edge-case match resolution such as simultaneous army wipe or base destruction.
Simplify or relax the total assault unlock rule for the prototype.
soon: Rework battlefield layout readability from rear base to central shrine to enemy front.
Make production and rally flow easier to read for first-time players.
Strengthen readability of the core infantry triangle: spearman, shield infantry, rifleman.
Reduce HUD wording and information density.
later: Reduce extension-unit emphasis and refocus combat on the core infantry triangle.
Do a first pass on battlefield environment polish to reduce test-map feel.
Set build scenes and execution baseline for a replayable prototype build.
